transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. AI. What brings you in today?
I've been feeling deeply depressed and completely empty inside for about a year now. It's just a constant, heavy sadness that I can't seem to shake off no matter what.
Have there been any periods of at least two months during this year when you felt back to your usual self, or has the low mood been present most days without much break?
No, there haven't been any breaks like that at all. I have felt this heavy sadness continuously every single day for the past year. I haven't had a single moment where I felt back to my usual self.
